headline: Tombstones Stay on Top as Jockeys and Outlaws Surge Up the Board
lede: Boom. League sources tell me the Tombstones remain the king of the Pecking Order at #1, riding a 4-game winning streak and a 77.4% all-play mark. Money is nice, but championships are better, and the Tombstones look like they are playing for the big prize.

rankings.blurb: Tombstones are the top dog at #1 with a 77.4% all-play mark and a 4-game winning streak, and nobody in this league is scoring more consistently over the last three weeks.
Barracudas sit at #2 with a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks and 176.4 PPG, and they are the hottest scoring team in the top of the board right now.
Monsters rocketed up 10 spots to #3 with a 4-game winning streak and a 74.9% all-play mark, and sources say they are the biggest riser in the top five.
Demons are holding steady at #4 with a 5-1 record over the last three weeks and a 72.6% all-play mark, a quiet but dangerous contender.
Nemesis climbed 7 spots to #5 on a 5-game winning streak and a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks, and they are looking like a real problem for the top teams.
Chickens are sitting pretty at #6 with a 13-game winning streak, the longest active run in the league, and a perfect 6-0 over the last three weeks.
Kraken dropped 3 spots to #7 despite a perfect 6-0 over the last three weeks and a 10-game winning streak, and that is a tough fall to swallow.
Dawgs blew up up 10 spots to #8 with a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks and a 3-game winning streak, a big-time rise from #18.
Chargers jumped 5 spots to #9 on a 4-game winning streak and a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks, a steady climb up the board.
Monkeys slipped 3 spots to #10 despite a 5-1 record over the last three weeks, a sign that their scoring has cooled off.
Razerbacks are the biggest faller in the top ten, dropping 9 spots from #2 to #11 even with a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks.
Hurricanes dipped 3 spots to #12 with a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks and a 2-game winning streak, still dangerous but not the same team.
Hoosiers climbed 4 spots to #13 on a 7-game winning streak and a perfect 6-0 over the last three weeks, a team that is heating up fast.
Jockeys surged 17 spots to #14 with a 5-1 record over the last three weeks, one of the biggest jumps on the entire board.
KitKats jumped 11 spots to #15 on a 4-game winning streak, and they are riding momentum into the middle of the top 25.
Bombers climbed 6 spots to #16 with a 4-game winning streak and a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks, a solid move up the board.
Yeti's fell 9 spots to #17 with a 3-3 mark over the last three weeks, and sources say they need to find some consistency fast.
Deadly rocketed up 35 spots to #18 with a 4-game winning streak and a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks, the most dramatic rise on the board.
BearCats leaped 35 spots to #19 on a 5-game winning streak and a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks, a huge climb from #54.
Cellmates dropped 9 spots to #20 and are sitting on a 3-game losing streak, a rough stretch for a team that was higher on the board.
Rams jumped 11 spots to #21 with a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks, a strong rebound from #32.
Fox rocketed up 17 spots to #22 with a 3-3 mark over the last three weeks and 149.4 PPG, a team that is finding its scoring rhythm.
Apes surged 13 spots to #23 on a 4-game winning streak and a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks, a big-time move up the board.
Outlaws climbed 25 spots to #24 with a 2-game winning streak and a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks, one of the more impressive jumps this week.
Spiders dropped 9 spots to #25 despite a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks, a frustrating fall for a team that is still winning games.

statOfWeek.title: Stat of the Week
statOfWeek.blurb: Lumberjacks dropped 214.17 this week, the highest score in the league. Boom, that is a monster week and a reminder of what this team can do.

benchBlunder.title: Bench Blunder of the Week
benchBlunder.blurb: Mafia left 71.15 points on the bench this week, scoring 135.13 when they could have had 206.28. League sources say that is a painful lineup mistake.

heaterOfWeek.title: Heater of the Week
heaterOfWeek.blurb: Chickens have won 13 straight, the longest active win streak in the league. This team is on fire and nobody is stopping them right now.

coolerOfWeek.title: Cooler of the Week
coolerOfWeek.blurb: Chupacabras have dropped 12 in a row, the longest active losing streak in the league. Ouch, that is a brutal run that needs fixing fast.

matchupOfWeek.title: Matchup of the Week
matchupOfWeek.blurb: Week 9 brings #7 Kraken at #2 Barracudas, the highest-ranked clash on the slate. This is the matchup to circle on your calendar.
